request.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

M1 ash-rat FRONT MODEL REFERENCE for the approved project, 1536x1024 landscape PNG. Adapt the attached approved project drawing style to the new creature described here. First establish ONE ordinary ash rat, full body in strict straight-on front view, neutral crouching quadruped stance, both forepaws planted, small eyes symmetrically visible, with the body behind its head and the hairless tail extending visibly behind and curving to one side on the ground. No dramatic attack or snarling wolf pose. Draw a rodent, not a reptile, rabbit, dog or armoured creature. Rat ears, tapering rodent muzzle, chisel incisors, thin crooked but anatomically jointed limbs. Four grounded paws, no extra limbs. Standard rat is about 70 cm nose to rump plus its hairless tail, knee-high beside an adult man in its hunched stance. This is NOT the swarm mother: no bony dorsal spurs.

Scale: place ONE faint grey featureless 178 cm man silhouette beside it, on the exact same baseline and at the same orthographic scale, so the rat's hunched back reaches the man's knee. Use the attached human sheet only for normal adult body proportions, but draw no face, costume or details on this silhouette. Keep the rat small relative to the full adult height rather than enlarging it to fill the frame. The creature's real 70 cm body length is not foreshortened into a new stubby species: body is naturally hidden behind the head by the strict front camera. Tail remains visible beside the body. Camera horizontal and orthographic, no forced perspective.

The design: patchy hairless warm-grey hide #7A7570 with irregular BLACK BLOTCHES; lean hunched bony shoulders and hips, ribs subtly suggested. Small eyes leak a few hand-drawn violet ash wisps #6B4C9A, not broad glowing beams, and thin cracks down the spine leak the same violet ash, only a little visible above the shoulders in this front view. No black face-hole and no red, cyan or amber light. Long paired yellow-brown CHISEL incisors visible at the slightly parted mouth, not a mouthful of fangs. Thin crooked limbs and pink-grey claws. Matte sparse skin creases, black tapered contour, one hard cool shadow mass per body part; no glossy skin, 3D render or airbrush polish. No decorative stone plates or reptilian scales copied from the lizard reference. The lizard sheet supplies the rough creature line treatment and matte cel shadow technique ONLY. The two acting panels supply house ink/colour technique only, not their characters, setting or light.

Flat light-grey #E9E9EC background with no vignette, gradient or texture; soft neutral light from upper left on the creature, small contact shadows below paws and silhouette only. No labels, no measuring lines, no numbers, no extra heads or inserts. This is a single front reference, not the four-view turnaround. One monster plus the required scale silhouette.

Ash rats: hunched, bony rats about 70 cm long plus a hairless tail, with patchy hairless grey hide blotched black, small eyes leaking violet ash, long yellow-brown chisel incisors, thin crooked limbs with pink-grey claws, and thin cracks along the spine leaking violet ash; a swarm of dozens.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
